item.title: Meet with the Superintendent Sessions
item.description:
The Superintendent is hosting two community meetings at the Administrative Offices (131 W. Chestnut Street, Oxford, OH 45056): - November 2, 2026 at 4 PM: Information on the new Attendance Law, 40 by 2040 federal funding, and Talawanda financials - November 13, 2026 at 7:30 or 8 AM: Information on property taxes, school funding, and Talawanda financials. Bring your coffee!

item.title: Health Education Curriculum Update on Senate Bill 288
item.description:
The district will conduct Senate Bill 288 (Erin's Law) health education instruction from October 12-26, 2026, covering sexual abuse and sexual violence prevention education (K-12). Families can review grade-level curricula through provided links covering topics like social inclusion, dating violence/healthy relationships, and suicide prevention. Parents may opt their students out by contacting their student's school counselor.

Curriculum links available for: - K-3, 4-6, 7-8 (TMS), and 9-12 (THS) grade levels - Topics: Social Inclusion, Dating Violence, Suicide Prevention

item.title: Miami University Mentorship Program for Juniors/Seniors
item.description:
Juniors and seniors can sign up for a mentorship program with Miami University college students who will visit during Tutorial Period every other Friday. Mentors can answer questions about college majors, life after high school, and the application process. Interested students should fill out the Mentorship Interest Form or email hopeandafutureclub@gmail.com with questions.
